    let feedbackNodes = [];
    function stopFeedbackAudio() {
      clearTimeout(encouragementTimer);
      feedbackAudio.pause();
      feedbackAudio.currentTime = 0;
      feedbackNodes.forEach(node => { try { node.stop(); } catch (_) {} });
      feedbackNodes = [];
    }
    async function playFeedbackRecording(source) {
      stopIntroSequence();
      stopKasroonVoice();
      lastLearningAudio = {type: 'feedback', source};
      if (!soundEnabled) return;
      stopWelcomeAudio();
      stopConceptAudio();
      stopDialogueAudio();
      feedbackAudio.pause();
      feedbackAudio.src = source;
      feedbackAudio.currentTime = 0;
      try { await feedbackAudio.play(); }
      catch (error) { if (error.name !== 'AbortError') showToast('اضغط على زر الصوت ثم حاول مجددًا'); }
    }
    function playCelebrationEffect(kind) {
      if (!soundEnabled || access.quiet) return;
      try {
        const ctx = getAudioCtx();
        if (!ctx) return;
        const now = ctx.currentTime;
        if (kind === 'applause') {
          for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, Math.ceil(ctx.sampleRate * 0.09), ctx.sampleRate);
            const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
            for (let j = 0; j < data.length; j++) data[j] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.exp(-j / (ctx.sampleRate * 0.018));
            const source = ctx.createBufferSource(), gain = ctx.createGain(), filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
            source.buffer = buffer; filter.type = 'highpass'; filter.frequency.value = 850;
            gain.gain.value = 0.14;
            source.connect(filter); filter.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            source.start(now + i * 0.047); feedbackNodes.push(source);
          }
        } else {
          // A short, layered rising whoop, synthesized locally.
          for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const voice = ctx.createOscillator(), filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter(), gain = ctx.createGain();
            const start = now + i * 0.035;
            voice.type = 'sawtooth';
            voice.frequency.setValueAtTime(220 + i * 27, start);
            voice.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(480 + i * 34, start + 0.3);
            voice.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(330 + i * 20, start + 0.7);
            filter.type = 'bandpass'; filter.frequency.value = 1050 + i * 130; filter.Q.value = 1.2;
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, start);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.045, start + 0.1);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, start + 0.75);
            voice.connect(filter); filter.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            voice.start(start); voice.stop(start + 0.8); feedbackNodes.push(voice);
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    function playSuccessSound() {
      stopFeedbackAudio();
      if (!soundEnabled) return;
      playCelebrationEffect(successEffectIndex++ % 2 === 0 ? 'cheer' : 'applause');
      encouragementTimer = setTimeout(() => speakEncouragement(), 1000);
    }

    function playErrorSound() {
      stopFeedbackAudio();
      pendingEncouragement = false;
      if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackRecording(feedbackRecordings.error);
    }

    function playClickSound() {
      playTone(440, 0.06, 'sine', 0);
    }
